title: Power Apps: Create responsive, multi-column forms for SharePoint lists (preview)
description: The public preview of SharePoint Customize Forms introduces a responsive, multi-column starting layout for new forms in eligible commercial SharePoint tenants. Makers can customize these forms while preserving their connection to SharePoint list actions. Existing customized forms retain their current layouts.
